column1: # title: RX video stable (SCDT on): FIFO reset and TX port 1 power-on
# TX port 1 power-on rows (from '58 0 08' to '18 80 80') are also table splitter-tx1-power-on.tsv.
# variable r14: value read from 0x70 reg 0x14 in this table. The 'cond: 0x11 bit3' / '0x12' rows ran at
# T3/S31 t=37240.1, where the AVI events arrived with SCDT on.
# columns: n op dev bank reg mask value note
# ops: W write value; M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | (value & mask); R read (value: traced example or '-');
#      P poll until (reg & mask) == value (interval/timeout in note); D delay, value = ms; X step described in the chapter
# dev: 8-bit I2C address. bank: 0x58 bank 0-1, 0x70 bank 0-3, '-' unbanked device, '*' the bank register 0x0f itself
# value: hex; {read} = write back the value read from this register earlier in the table (W1C acknowledge);
#        {expr} = computed, variables defined in the chapter; '/' is integer division
# note: 'cond:' marks a conditional row; 'RD: RMW mask ff' = RD reads first, a plain write is equivalent

column8: cond: 0x10 bit2 set (traced in T3/S20 with 0x10 = 06)
TX port 1 HPD (bit0) gates its power-on
tx-clock-measure: measure TX clock -> clk [kHz], chapter 7.3
input colour depth, bits 5:4 (scales clk for 10/12-bit)
TX port 2 HPD: no sink, skipped
cond: 0x11 bit3; input colour depth in bits 5:4
avi-read: cond: 0x12 bit0; read AVI InfoFrame, bank 2 regs 0x12-0x23, until stable (chapter 6.7)
csc-program: cond: 0x12 bit0; optional: splitter CSC blocks, unused by the bypass path (chapter 6.7)
